title: Pure Pwnage
summary: "Kyle and Jeremy carry on their tradition of effortlessly winning at everything. Now middle aged they decide to dump their hot girlfriends and quit their high paying but boring jobs to play video games instead. Along the way they enjoy more of the best of everything and of course, pwn noobs. A low effort male fantasy for adult children." Pure Pwnage was a webseries and a short-lived HBO show before it was a feature film.
